title: Sherpa voice transcription, recording and playback through the UI
description: Drives the sherpa-voice screens the way a user does: transcribes the bundled JFK sample with streaming-zipformer-en-20m-mobile on the ASR screen and asserts the shown transcript, records four seconds in Live Mic mode and asserts the on-screen duration, then generates speech with vits-icefall-en-low on the TTS screen and plays it until it finishes. Controls without a testID are pressed by their label through the React fiber tree. Models are downloaded through the bridge as setup when missing. Used as the before/after proof for SDK upgrades on Android and iOS. Needs microphone permission granted; downloaded models stay on the device. Pass live_mic=false on a target whose host denies microphone access (opening the input there aborts the app); the record claim then reports missing.

proofTargets.claim: The ASR screen transcribes the bundled JFK sample and shows the words.
Live Mic mode records from the microphone and stops from its buttons.
Generated speech plays from the TTS screen and finishes.
The run ends on the route it started from.
